item.title: Illinois Democratic hopefuls for US Senate agree Trump poses constitutional crisis but other differences emerge
item.description: The three main Democratic candidates for US Senate agreed in saying the nation is facing a constitutional crisis under President Donald Trump, yet small but distinct differences among the candidates emerged.

item.title: Nick Martinelli and Tre Singleton help Northwestern keep Penn State winless in the Big Ten with 94-73 rout
item.description: Nick Martinelli scored 34 points and Tre Singleton notched a massive double-double as Northwestern beat Penn State 94-73 on Thursday night in Evanston.

item.title: Struggling Chicago Blackhawks allow 4 second-period goals in another blowout loss to the Pittsburgh Penguins
item.description: The Chicago Blackhawks allowed six unanswered goals in a 6-2 loss to the Pittsburgh Penguins on Thursday night. It was their fourth straight defeat and seventh in nine games.

item.title: 4 takeaways from the Chicago Bulls’ 116-113 loss to the Miami Heat, including Ayo Dosunmu’s 4th-quarter effort
item.description: Ayo Dosunmu scored 15 of his 23 points in the fourth quarter Thursday, but the Chicago Bulls' comeback fell short in a 116-113 loss to the Miami Heat.

item.title: No. 9 Illinois wins its 10th straight, riding Keaton Wagler’s 22 points to a 75-66 victory over Washington
item.description: Keaton Wagler had 22 points and eight assists and No. 9 Illinois extended its winning streak to 10 games with a 75-66 victory over Washington on Thursday night.

item.title: Asking Eric: She is always angry
item.description: Dear Eric: My husband and I are in our 70s and have never really been able to get close with our daughter-in-law. She has a very explosive temper and yells, slams doors and has what I call tantrums.
